text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm about to apply a Terraform change that converts svc/frontend-api in staging from NodePort -> LoadBalancer + adds externalTrafficPolicy: Local and a proxy-protocol annotation. Quick sanity check before I hit apply?

priya: Which TF resource exactly? Are you changing the k8s_service or the aws_lb config?

alex: k8s_service. Snippet from the module: 
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service" "frontend_api" {
  metadata {
    name = "frontend-api"
    annotations = {
      "service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-target-type" = "instance"
      "service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-proxy-protocol" = "*"  # enabling proxy-proto v2
    }
  }
  spec {
    type = "LoadBalancer"
    external_traffic_policy = "Local"
    port {
      name = "http"
      port = 443
      target_port = 8080
      protocol = "TCP"
    }
  }
}
```

jamie: Couple of things to watch: with type=LoadBalancer on AWS the NLB targets the nodePort under the hood. externalTrafficPolicy: Local means nodes without pods for the svc will not receive traffic — ensure pod distribution is even or we'll end up with unhealthy nodes from NLB healthchecks.

jen (ops note): also be careful about port naming: some controllers and apps use the port name prefix to infer L7 vs L4. If you intend TLS handling at the ingress/gateway, name it `https` or `tls-http` accordingly.

priya: How are you terminating TLS? NLB + proxy-protocol implies TLS passthrough to pods (pod must handle TLS) unless you're also creating an ALB/Ingress that terminates. If you want the NLB to do TLS termination you need the TLS listener on the LB and cert attached at the LB (not common with k8s Service type=LoadBalancer).

alex: We plan to terminate TLS in the app (pods) for this service — so NLB will be TCP-proxying. That's why I enabled proxy-protocol to preserve client IP.

jamie: OK. Then two actionable checks: 1) add the aws-load-balancer-healthcheck-port annotation to point at the nodePort (or the port number) so healthchecks align, and 2) ensure your pods present a valid cert for SNI if you rely on SNI-based routing in the app.

maria: Also check the port name: if you use Gateway API in some clusters, the route matching may require the port name to start with `tls-` or `https-` for TLS semantics. So pick a name that downstream controllers expect.

alex: Good catch. I can change port.name = "https-main". For healthcheck annotation, do you mean: 
```yaml
service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-healthcheck-port: "https"
service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-healthcheck-protocol: "TCP"
```
Will that point the NLB health check to the service port name?

jamie: Healthcheck-port accepts port number or `traffic-port`/`health` in some contexts. Using `traffic-port` is safest: `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-healthcheck-port: "traffic-port"` so it follows the service port on the NLB listener. If you need instance-level checks, set the numeric nodePort.

priya: One more: since you're enabling proxy-protocol, ensure your ingress/nginx (or app) is configured to accept proxy-protocol headers — otherwise TLS handshake will fail. For our nginx image we have `use-proxy-protocol: "true"` in the configmap. For raw apps, you may need to adjust the listener.

infra-bot: terraform plan: module.frontend.kubernetes_service.frontend_api will be updated (type, externalTrafficPolicy, annotations). 1 to change, 0 to add, 0 to destroy. No IAM changes detected.

alex: Thanks. Plan looks small. I'll: 1) switch port.name to `https-main`, 2) add healthcheck-port=traffic-port, 3) leave proxy-protocol but double-check pod TLS config and nginx proxy flag, 4) run canary apply to staging only.

maria: And remember to create/confirm the TLS secrets if pods terminate TLS. If you were terminating at LB/ALB we'd wire the cert into the LB resource instead.

priya: one last note — verify targetPort resolves correctly (some services reference numeric targetPort, others a named port on the container). If you use a name for the container port, targetPort should match that name.

alex: Got it. I'll push the small TF tweak and ping the thread once applied. Thanks :thumbsup:

priya: :+1:

jamie: 👍

infra-bot: apply queued for staging — plan approved by alex.
